accounting_and_failure: Durable closed-per-event attempted physical callback and staged operation JSONL; per-phase independent physical counts, all attempted internal meter snapshots, partial comparison JSONL and atomic RESULT updates retained on Python failure. An external kill leaves partial streams plus root termination receipt.
command_shape: <native_ncn Python> -B <this packet>/diagnose.py --execute-authorized --source-root <PHASE> --repository <same main repo> --device cuda:0 --output <fresh output> --public-b-dir <exact existing public+B projection>

comparisons.direct_pairwise: Within each member, all24492x5 logit coordinates.
comparisons.episode_vs_each_fresh: All adapted private coordinates FIRST, then every original committed diagnostic/probe CE/Q coordinate in predecessor expected traversal order.
comparisons.fresh_pairwise: All three pairs; exhaustive diagnostics/adapted/raw costs/Q/probe gradients/main gradients, every tensor coordinate.
comparisons.original_failure_limitation: New observed failing paths identify this fixed diagnostic reproduction; the original receipt itself contains no offending path/value, so identical original path is not assumed.
comparisons.original_tensor_rule: torch.allclose(actual, expected, atol=2e-6, rtol=2e-5); torch.isclose supplies coordinate violation counts. Integer tensors and scalar metadata retain exact equality.
comparisons.summary: Every comparison retains first failing path and maximum error path; no tolerance-based early abort or averaging-away discrepancy.
comparisons.tensor_path_records: One JSONL row per tensor path: shape/dtype/device, every-coordinate violation and finite counts, actual/expected max/RMS scale, max/RMS absolute error, exact max-error index/value/limit plus first8 violating indices/values/limits. Scalar metadata/structure mismatches also recorded.

fixed_schedule_order: fresh response1 plus full private/diagnostic comparisons
fresh response2 plus full private/diagnostic comparisons
fresh response3 plus full private/diagnostic comparisons
output_status: DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE_NO_QUALIFICATION on schedule completion even when original tolerance violations are present; FAIL_DIAGNOSTIC_EXECUTION on execution/structure/count/restoration exception. No PASS status.
purpose: Describe every observed tolerance failure path and same-state repeat variability after the original first-LIVE diagnostic mismatch; no pass promotion.

resources.whole_process_measurements: Elapsed/RSS/CUDA peak allocated and reserved including imports/setup/state snapshots/comparison logging; no peak reset.

restoration: Original native parameters/alias identities/modes/attributes/buffers/public inputs/Python-NumPy-Torch-CUDA RNG checked with unchanged BASE; original theta/phi values/flags and returned theta+ values/flags checked. All constructed episode/response states remain memory only and are discarded.

scope.direct_logits: Two separate complete native forwards for each of four original member phi rows at that same theta+, within torch.no_grad.
scope.fresh_response_phi: ORIGINAL input phi rows, never episode-adapted phi.
scope.fresh_response_theta: The same single returned theta+ from the one episode; value/flags checked unchanged.

source_and_process_gates: Worker/full-six qualifier/operator/port/sequential remain false; existing separately reviewed engineering accessor stays true. No gate flipping, including during future diagnostic.
